result:
I’d make genuine empathy unavoidable.

Not sympathy. Not pity. The ability to truly feel, even briefly, what another person’s life has taught them—their fear, hunger, humiliation, hope.

A lot of cruelty, corruption, and indifference become harder when the suffering of others stops being abstract.
